description: Marion, IA – Ashley Hinson launched a new ad for the general election today, “Aisle.” The ad is set to air on broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms across Iowa. [Watch Here] “It used to be that reaching across the aisle wasn’t just okay, it was expected. Some people in Washington forgot that. I never have. That’s why I worked with Democrats to expand mental healthcare for veterans and with President Trump to take on big health insurance companies to lower your costs. Working across the aisle isn’t always easy, but it’s how you get results.” No matter who is in office or who holds the majority, Ashley has been an effective, bipartisan leader for Iowans: ###

title: Hinson Releases New Ad: “Aisle” - Ashley Hinson for Iowa
